besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses (Soutwater bevat / ons vind).
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma; no words added.

besluite.fout: Stranded 'in' after existential 'daar' reads as spoken style, and 'sout' is repeated woodenly.
besluite.rede: 'daarin' and 'dit' read naturally, the word count is unchanged, and 'dit' can only mean the salt, so the meaning stays.

besluite.fout: Comma before 'en' inside a list of places, against AWS 2017, in an overlong sentence.
besluite.rede: A real punctuation fault; the new sentence keeps every place and leaves the protected 'die meeste mere en die meeste vleilande' intact, so the two added words are justified.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses (water le / daardie water is).
besluite.rede: Both halves are full clauses with their own subject and verb, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses (Die son maak / van die water verander).
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.
'styg op in die lug' is a natural Afrikaans placement of the prepositional phrase after the particle and is not ambiguous, so the proposal is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'dit' points back to 'waterdamp' (the previous sentence's 'jy kan dit nie sien nie'), so the sentence reads as if water vapour is called evaporation.
besluite.rede: A real reference fault on a key term; 'hierdie verandering' points to the change into vapour, which is what evaporation is, at the cost of one word.

besluite.fout: 'bly agter in die see' can be misread as 'at the back of the sea' and leaves the particle of 'agterbly' mid-clause.
besluite.rede: 'bly in die see agter' is the natural order and removes the misreading without changing meaning or length.
Both clauses hang on the shared opener 'Na 'n ruk' (hence the inverted 'le daar'), so it is one sentence and a comma would split the shared element.

besluite.fout: The glossary entry 'Water met baie sout in' ends in a spoken-style stranded 'in' and does not match the parallel varswater entry ('wat baie min sout bevat').
besluite.rede: A real style fault, but it rewords a shared glossary definition beyond a plain grammar or spelling error, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once.
